workouts.title: Week Overview
workouts.description:
Welcome to the gymnastics re-test. This week we will re-test the focus pieces from 5 weeks ago, keep in mind this is a short cycle but that doesn’t mean you can’t improve. Even minor improvements, when it comes to gymnastics, go a long way in this sport.

Good luck & Have fun :)
